text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whaaat! That's totally wild, y'know... Chiyo-chan, you're all by yourself tonight?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's right~. Ardan-san had to stay out overnight for Mejiro family matters, so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A bit sentimental, huh? I totally get it! Back when I first started living on my own, I felt the exact same way~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, decided! Big sister's gonna crash at your place just for tonight☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eh—Eeehh~?! Maruzen-san, in my room...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wao♪ It's been forever since I ate at the dorm cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Chiyo-chan! Since we're here, why don't we cook dinner together? Let's hype up the vibes and get cooking!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'd love to! ...Ehehe, you seem really excited, Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, it feels just like a school trip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Having everyone around in the middle of the night gets my engine revvin'♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, Maruzen-san is staying over at the dorm tonight? It sounds like it will be quite the special evening~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Au... that sounds nice... Rice wants to hang out with Maruzen-san too... Uu, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, why don't you join in too, Rice-chan? Let's catch night fever together tonight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the night deepened...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Head over heels for romance♪ Welcome to the Miho Dormitory Love Talk Extravaganza~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! *Party horn noises*~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sleepovers are made for this! Spill your juicy romance stories to big sis!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Me, me, meee! I'll go first! Okay, so I was walking through town the other day, and I bumped right into my first crush—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl J
text_block_list.text: —And then they confessed and we started dating, but turns out... they were my childhood friend!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wah! D-Dating your childhood friend...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Then it's time to study up on adult romance!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Like sending secret pager codes like '114106' [I love you]! Doesn't just thinking about it get your motor running?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let's all watch a trendy drama right now! That'll definitely teach us about mature romance—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heyyy!! Just how late are you planning to stay up?! Get back to your rooms already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One morning, while walking in front of the dormitory, I spotted Maruzensky and Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...
choice_data_list: Good morning. You look pretty sleepy.
Good morning. You look pretty sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, you caught me looking uncool. See, I got way too hyped at the sleepover and couldn't get much shut-eye...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I feel bad for Chiyo-chan. I stayed over to cheer her up, but ended up keeping her awake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Seeing you have such a great time was the best part, Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hearing you say that takes a load off my mind... But next time, I've gotta act like a proper big sister!
